title: Being Right for Whose Right Reasons?

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the alignment of model rationales (extracted via Attention Rollout and Layer-wise Relevance Propagation) with human-annotated rationales provided by two different age groups (under 36 and over 37 years old).

Comparing the alignment of model rationales (extracted via explainability methods) with human-annotated rationales provided by annotators from three ethnic groups (Black/African American, Latino/Hispanic, and White/Caucasian).
